'''Kri-Ta Outpost''' was an outpost of the [[Voss commandos]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]], a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] that was largely under the control of the warlike [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
